blockingLoop.evidence: Final reply repeats the earlier one almost verbatim: 'Could you please provide the model number... usually found on a label on the side edge of the door' after the customer said the sticker is peeled and nothing else is reachable.

rationale: The assistant correctly tied the loose right-side spring to the door dropping and had the customer unplug the machine. After that it looped: it asked again for a model number the customer had already said was unreadable. It also said 'that's enough to move forward with confidence' for a partial model, then did nothing with it. It never advised pulling the unit out safely, replacing springs or cables as a pair, checking the hinges, or calling an engineer, and the final turn was a near copy of the previous one.
